info.description: Typed REST API on Fastify 5. Authenticate with a Bearer JWT issued by this host or an X-API-Key / Bearer bask_<prefix>_<secret>. This host is a resource server plus a social login client, not an OAuth authorization server. It does not expose MCP, GraphQL, or a plugin manifest.
